ctx.x: Andy Kirk. All the big name bands. It was a band here by the name of Paul Banks. He was there. Well, he had a band out of -- down the road here in Missouri -- Sedalia -- Sedalia Night Hawks, they had about an eight piece band. It was a good little band but --
How about Jay McShann, was he there?
